name: A team climbs a mountain toward a shared total
looks: A dotted path winds up a stylised mountain illustration; a glowing marker travels along it as a team step-total climbs in the corner, from a base camp through a high camp to a summit ridge, each waypoint lighting up and naming itself as the marker reaches it. On the final cut, several small avatar markers cluster at the peak under a glowing "SUMMIT" title as the total completes.
build: Pre-drawn SVG path; marker position via `getPointAtLength` tied to the same value driving the cumulative counter. Waypoint pills cross-fade dim to lit the instant the marker passes, each with a short pulse. The payoff title fades/scales in over the illustration once the total reaches its target, holding longer than the other waypoints did.
sound: A soft ambient wind bed under the climb, a chime on each waypoint unlocking, a fuller resolving chord on the summit payoff.
prompt: Wind a dotted path up a stylised landscape illustration and travel a glowing marker along it as a shared cumulative total climbs, lighting up named waypoints in turn as the marker passes each one, and close on a glowing payoff title once several small markers converge at the final point together.
